title: OverSire suggestion
description: The only output of an AI job. The user accepts or dismisses it. An accepted proposal becomes a vendor write, a work order or a memory entry. Dates are ISO 8601 UTC.

Proposal.description: What happens on accept. The target is the subject of the suggestion.

Area.description: A code area tag, for example queue-ui. Lower case.

SequenceDraft.description: The proposal of a sequence job: relations of the subject item and its code areas. The lines of the proposal, for SuggestionEdit.drop, are in this order: each relations.add entry, each relations.remove entry, then one line for all areas when areas is not empty.

areas.description: The areas of the subject item. Empty: no change to the areas.

SuggestionEdit.description: What the user removed before Accept. The user can only remove lines, never add text.

drop.description: The indexes of the proposal lines to drop.

kind.description: The Job kind. Open set: triage, failureReason, digest, changeSummary, tidy, memoryUpkeep.

proposal.description: Missing: the suggestion only informs. Accept then sets it to done. A reader that does not know the proposal type keeps it as it is.

edit.description: Set with state accepted. On accept, the hub drops these lines from the proposal, saves the edited proposal and removes the edit.

dedupeKey.description: Subject, kind and subject version. A job does not write a second open suggestion with the same key.

subjectVersion.description: The vendor version of the subject, for example its updatedAt or head SHA.

decidedBy.description: The device id that accepted or dismissed.

jobRun.description: The JobRun id that wrote the suggestion.
